resourceName: Methane capture and destruction on La Hormiga landfill in San Felipe and El Belloto landfill in Quilpue
description: The project activity is to build, operate and maintain a landfill gas (LFG) collection and flaring system on the La Hormiga landfill in San Felipe and El Belloto landfill in Quilpue. The project aims at designing, building and operating a highly efficient landfill gas (LFG) collection and flaring system to burn the landfill gas collected on each of the sites. At a later stage, the landfill gas collected may be used as fuel for energy utilisation (thermal, electricity or any other suitable ways). Besides climate change mitigation, the project would have important local environmental benefits. Currently, most of the landfill gas is released into the atmosphere without any treatment or control. This implies a potential fire and explosion risk as well as bad odours. Moreover, landfill gas contains trace amounts of volatile organic compounds, which are air pollutants.
